v1.1.0 Resource Update (2026.11.20.R13):
- Upgraded SignatureDemoLib.dll to v2.0.3.0 Universal CNG+CSP Engine (Native Win32 CryptSignMessage)
- Fixes 'Unable to read token: Invalid algorithm specified.' on Modify Token Number / Read Token (filters out Encryption-only certs, supports CNG KSP & legacy CSP)
- Fixes 'Both signing methods failed.' on MeeSeva Approvals / Birth & Death Signing via 5-tier universal signing cascade
- Fixes 'Unable to Sign: [object Error]' on Bulk Signing by enforcing Fusion-synced COM registration & clearing IE ActiveX Kill-Bits
- Keeps Anti-Tamper protection, Windows 7 Deactivation fix, Old DSC Cert Cleaner, and State-Isolated UBD sites.xml
